subject: Proofpoint POC: scope, target metrics, model shortlist & owners
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@proofpoint.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proofpoint POC: initial recap & proposed success plan

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can get the POC moving this week. High-level takeaways: you want to validate our inference latency/cost profile and NER/intent accuracy on customer support transcripts in English + Spanish, and confirm a safe fallback when production traffic spikes.

Proposed POC scope (2-week evaluation):
- Dataset: 5k anonymized support transcripts (English 70%, Spanish 30%) — Proofpoint to share by EOD Thu 11/26.
- Models to trial (initial shortlist): Mistral-Instruct-7B, Llama-2-13B-Chat, and a quantized Llama-2-7B Q4 fallback for cost/latency baseline.
- Success metrics: intent classification F1 >= 0.88, NER token recall >= 0.85, hallucination incidents < 3% (manual sample), p95 latency < 250ms for typical 256-token responses, throughput target 12 req/s sustained on a single dedicated slot.
- Ops constraints: customer data must remain in a VPC; logs for evaluation to be redacted and shared via our secure drive.

Owners (suggested):
- Proofpoint: Elena (data & stakeholder coordination), Tom (SRE/infra)
- Redwood: Jonas (PoC owner / commercial), Marcus (inference engineer / model runs), Monica (customer success / evaluation lead)

Near-term timeline (proposed):
- Thu 11/26: dataset delivery + signed minimal SOW (I attached a POC one-pager).
- Mon 11/29: kickoff, env access & sample run (day 0).
- Week 1 (11/29–12/03): run models on sample subset, refine prompts & guardrails.
- Week 2 (12/06–12/10): full evaluation window, metrics collection, final review the week of 12/13.

Next steps: can you confirm dataset delivery date and whether Proofpoint requires a company-specific NDA before we ingest data? Also please confirm the two internal owners above. If this looks good, I’ll send a short SOW and calendar invites for the kickoff.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: proofpoint-poc-scope-v1.pdf (POC one-pager)
From: Elena Rojas <elena@proofpoint.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@proofpoint.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proofpoint POC: initial recap & proposed success plan

Thanks Jonas — this is great and aligned to what we discussed. Quick clarifications:

- Dataset delivery: we can deliver a redacted batch of 1k transcripts by Thu 11/26 and the full 5k by Mon 11/29 (SFTP link).
- NDA: we have a standard DPA/NDA in procurement — I’ll start that today; target signature by Fri 11/27.
- Multilingual needs: Spanish is critical for our LATAM customers; we also asked for German support later in the pilot but that can be out-of-scope for the first run.
- Fallback behavior: we need a soft-fallback that routes to a distilled quantized model (faster, cheaper) and an escalation path to a human queue when confidence is low. Can Redwood provide routing policy examples?

I attached an internal evaluation rubric (eval-rubric.xlsx) with priority use cases. I’ll confirm internal owners: Elena (data), Tom (infra), and I’ll loop in procurement once the SOW is in your hands.

Appreciate the clear timeline — please send the SOW and access checklist and we’ll expedite.

—Elena
Elena Rojas
Head of Integrations | Proofpoint
elena@proofpoint.com

Attachment: eval-rubric.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Proofpoint POC: infra & model plan (internal)

Quick internal note after reviewing the rubric Elena attached. Ops checklist and technical approach:

- Environment: we’ll spin a dedicated private slot in us-west-2 with VPC peering and S3 ingestion via presigned URLs. Expect ~1–2 hours for network setup once credentials arrive.
- Data prep: ask Proofpoint to include a simple schema (utterance, timestamp, language, metadata). We’ll run a small sanitization pipeline (PII redaction rules) before model runs.
- Model shortlist rationale:
  * Mistral-Instruct-7B: best instruction-following quality for short CRM transcripts, lower memory footprint.
  * Llama-2-13B-Chat: stronger on nuanced context and cross-turn coreference; expect higher token cost but better intent recall.
  * Llama-2-7B Q4 (quantized): fallback for low-latency spikes and cost comparisons.
- Routing policy suggestion: primary -> Llama-2-13B-Chat (confidence >= 0.8), degrade -> Mistral-Instruct-7B (0.6–0.8), fallback -> Llama-2-7B-Q4 (<0.6) with soft-throttle to human queue if consecutive low-confidence hits >3.
- Instrumentation: we’ll capture p95 latency, tokens per response, confidence scores, and create a small dashboard in Redwood Console.

I’ll prepare the runbook and a quick prompt template for Monica to review. Can Jonas confirm whether Proofpoint wants token-level cost reports (per-request) during the POC?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff ML Engineer, Inference | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@proofpoint.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proofpoint POC: initial recap & proposed success plan

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next items from Redwood side:

1) SOW & kickoff: I attached a short SOW/engagement one-pager (proofpoint-poc-scope-v1.pdf) and a calendar invite for Mon 11/29 10:00 PT. Please confirm acceptance.
2) Dataset & NDA: Elena — 1k by Thu and 5k by Mon works. We’ll hold ingestion until DPA is signed; our legal team is ready to countersign when you send.
3) Instrumentation & cost reports: we will enable token-level cost telemetry and provide a per-request CSV export daily during the POC. Marcus will publish the runbook and prompt templates by kickoff.
4) Model routing & fallbacks: we’ll implement Marcus’s suggested confidence thresholds for routing. Monica will own the evaluation run and the metric dashboard; Monica, can you confirm you’ll run manual spot-checks for hallucination samples?

If Proofpoint confirms the dataset delivery and NDA timeline, we’ll treat this as green to go. Looking forward to getting started — we’ll aim to have the first sample runs in the environment within 24 hours of dataset receipt.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

Calendar: Kickoff Mon 11/29 10:00 PT (invitation sent)
